name: block-warning-card
use: A warning about the price or the risk of a decision the reader is about to make.
avoid: Ordinary notes or tips; more than one or two per page.

cases.title: The risk of setting up sign-in late
cases.why: The reader is about to postpone a decision that is expensive to postpone.

props.title: Set it up early
props.text: If sign-in breaks, nobody can open the protected pages, architects included.
